rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and ZIP when the email lookup failed, matching a single user ID. It used read-only tools to retrieve user details and the pending order, correctly identified the most expensive item and its price, and sought explicit confirmation before attempting any order change. When the tool disallowed item removal, the agent correctly explained the constraint and offered compliant alternatives. Upon the user’s confirmation, it cancelled the entire order using the proper tool, and the tool confirmed cancellation and refund. Final information (order cancelled, refund to original card) matched the tool output. The only minor assumption was the generic 5–7 business day refund timeline, but this did not contradict tool results. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
